layer_algebra_boundaries.BE: At a fixed nonzero affine map and nonzero diagonal factors, diagonal BE preserves entry cross-ratios and zero support across members.
layer_algebra_boundaries.additive: With B=0, deltaW=deltaB A and grad_A=0. For one plain SGD step with unit adapter scaling, deltaW_m=-eta G_m A_m.T A_m. This is a layer/old-state identity, not an Adam, deep-GNN expressivity, benefit or novelty theorem.
layer_algebra_boundaries.dictionary_equivalence: Signs/permutations or left-orthogonal rotations of A leave A.T A unchanged. Different matrix bytes do not imply different input subspaces or first function updates; full-rank orthogonal A gives the same projectorI.
layer_algebra_boundaries.graph_conditioning: A graph-derived feature covariance, graph-filtered TRAIN residual or generated structural gate already has saved ancestry. Actual graph alignment must beat a matched feature/random or topology-misaligned orientation at the same initial task-relevant geometry. layer_algebra_boundaries.noncontainment: Rankr additive pair differences have rank at most2r; BE pair differences can have higher rank. The affine families are generally incomparable, so additive is not universally more expressive.
